items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I recorded the first album I made with Max and Kenny Dorham and Sonny Rollins and Wynton Kelly and Paul Chambers

ctx.x: Did you travel with your own group? How did that work?

No. That was one of the disadvantages. I started to travel with my own band when I became a jazz singer. When I recorded the first album I made with Max and Kenny Dorham and Sonny Rollins and Wynton Kelly and Paul Chambers, I knew I was never going back to doing what I had been doing. I was going to work with these kind of musicians.
Why did you know that? What about it made you know that?
